description: The person sits down at the xp desktop and looks around
expected: Desktop picture, taskbar with Start, four desktop buttons, volume, clock

description: Move to Start and click it
expected: The Start menu opens: Terminal, Chat with a helper, four programs
A terminal window opens, a task button appears

description: Type ls with a slip (lss), correct it, then cat friday.md
expected: ls lists the notes (the slip is deleted before Return); cat prints the Friday list

description: Slip: open Start and click Chat with a helper by mistake, wanting the Editor
expected: Start menu opens, then the chat of the helper opens instead of an editor

description: Notice it is the chat, press Escape
Start again and pick the Editor
expected: A text editor opens on friday.md in its own window

description: Type a line in the editor, then save with Ctrl+O and Return
expected: The new line is in the text; the editor asks for the file name and keeps it

description: Drag the title bar of the editor to the right
expected: The window follows and bends like jelly, then settles

description: Click the terminal button on the taskbar
expected: The terminal comes to the front
A help window lists the keys in groups
The help closes, the windows stay

description: Press Super+A, the key the list names for the helper
expected: The chat opens with the helper's transcript

description: Click into the message field and type
expected: The field takes the keyboard; the text shows
The message is sent: the field empties

description: The helper asks a question; the person reads it
expected: A question card with Yes and No shows in the chat
The chat closes; only the paperclip stays
